heard: Voyager 1 would need 74,000 years to reach our nearest neighboring star. We often imagine Proxima Centauri is right next door at just 4.2 light years away. This red dwarf hides a roughly Earth-sized world orbiting within its habitable zone. Proxima Centauri B completes its year in 11.2 days, making it a tempting destination. There is even a second candidate planet orbiting much further into the cold. Since 1977, Voyager 1 has been racing into the void at 17 kilometers per second. But even at that blistering speed, our fastest probe is essentially standing still. The scale of the cosmos makes a human lifetime feel like a heartbeat. Bridging the four-light-year gap to our neighbors remains a staggering challenge.
